name: NorthWest
description: NorthWest: monophonic 2-oscillator wavetable synth after Tablor - effect modes (FM/sync/fold/warp), unison modes, 2 LFOs, 8-slot mod matrix, second filter with serial/parallel/split routing.
author: NorthWest project; based on Tablor by athousanddetails, after Wavetable (Roland Rabien / FigBug, BSD-3)
